page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768 GB of system memory, providing a resource ratio of 8 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio positions this instance as a resource-dense option for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without the overhead of local physical disks.

Given the memory-optimized configuration of 768 GB of RAM and 96 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs, the ecs.r9i.24xlarge is designed for memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and complex data processing tasks that fit entirely within system memory.
